title: Pacific Engagement visa (subclass 192) - Pacific Engagement stream

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
We will allocate up to 3,000 visas to eligible Pacific island and Timor-Leste nationals each year. Learn why we have introduced
the Pacific Engagement Visa – Australia’s new permanent visa.

You can only submit a Pacific Engagement visa (subclass 192) - Pacific Engagement stream application if we selected you in the ballot and invite you to apply.

See:
Factsheet - Pacific Engagement stream to learn more about the Pacific Engagement visa (subclass 192) Pacific Engagement stream
